title: medical_legal_document
description: Medical records and bills, and legal documents: attorney letters, demands, complaints, court filings, rulings, settlements. Contains PII/PHI.

party.description: Patient, plaintiff, or represented party the document is about.

dates_of_service_or_filing.description: Dates of medical service, or filing / hearing dates, as YYYY-MM-DD.

diagnoses_or_rulings.description: Diagnoses (with codes if present) or legal rulings / demands.

outcome.description: Treatment plan, case outcome, settlement, or current status.
